event.location_text: MALACCA STRAIT Approximately 2.5 nm southwest of Tanjung Ayam (Malaysia), in the westbound lane of the TSS

sources.title: Piracy monthly report July 2023
sources.text: While underway, four perpetrators were sighted unloading scrap metal from the barge. Upon receipt of the information, Malaysian Maritime Enforcement Agency (MMEA) dispatched a patrol boat to the location. The perpetrators were arrested and their boats seized. Initial
